decisions.title: Fund credit card paydown
decisions.situation: Card balances, limits, and due dates are being verified. Cards above 30% utilization or without autopay put credit standing at risk.
decisions.rec: Approve funding to bring every revolving card below 30% before its statement closing date, highest-risk cards first.
decisions.required: Approve the paydown total and funding account, or hold until card data is verified.
decisions.next: Kristine completes the card table, then schedules payments after approval.

decisions.title: Turn on autopay for cards without it
decisions.situation: Any card without autopay can miss a due date and trigger a late fee or credit report mark.
decisions.rec: Approve minimum-payment autopay on every card; Kristine pays planned paydowns separately.
decisions.required: Approve autopay setup on all cards listed as Off or Unknown.
decisions.next: Authorized signer enables autopay at each bank; Kristine confirms.

decisions.title: PPS 2025 tax returns — how to file
decisions.situation: Both 2025 returns (IRS Form 1120 and California Form 100) are prepared and checked. PPS lost money in its first year, so $0 is owed.
decisions.rec: File online with TaxAct (~$230). Same $0 tax, but it avoids California’s $100 paper-filing penalty and confirms acceptance in days.
decisions.required: Approve ~$230 for TaxAct, then sign Form 8879-CORP and California Form 8453-C.
decisions.next: Kristine sets line 15a to No, files both returns in TaxAct by Oct 31, and saves the acceptance emails.

decisions.title: Honda Accord lease buyout
decisions.situation: Juan needs to decide whether to buy out the Honda Accord lease. The payoff quote, fees, and deadline are still being confirmed.
decisions.rec: Get the written payoff quote first. Buy out only if the total is at or below the car's market value.
decisions.required: Buy out or return the vehicle, and choose how to pay.
